title: Fixed Three Curved-arm Sprinkler
description: One newly authored static garden-sprinkler appearance: two low elongated feet and a bridge carry a short upright stem, thick open hub and three complete hollow round tubes sweeping outward with same-handed curved raised tips. Each tube has genuine finite wall thickness and open terminal bores; a separate side inlet sleeve completes the silhouette. Nine closed editable meshes, three constant opaque PBR materials. Not a resized Y-shaped open channel, capped tripod turnstile or hose reel. Internal fluid connections through the hub are not modeled or claimed; no water, rotating mechanism, flow, irrigation performance, manufacture or safety claim. Metres, Z up, true whole bounds-centred ground origin. One static game-art prop.
